title: HissCurtain — SNR-driven LP, TPT filter, log-freq smoothing
description:
Implement Source/DSP/HissCurtain: progressive high-frequency reduction driven by high-band SNR, using a modulation-stable TPT low-pass with log-frequency cutoff smoothing.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §2.2 Hiss Curtain equations and §14 Hiss Curtain min/max ranges
- Parameter inventory mentions hissCurtain.minFreq, hissCurtain.maxFreq, hissCurtain.depth
- Existing Source/DSP/ filter prepare/reset style; CrossoverSplitter from f.1 if shared high-band energy helpers are useful (do not edit it)

Implement HissCurtain.h/.cpp:
- Cutting cutoff mapping (§2.2):
  Q_H = clamp((SNR_H - S_min) / (S_max - S_min), 0, 1)
  ln(f_c) = ln(f_min) + Q_H * (ln(f_max) - ln(f_min))
  f_c = exp(ln(f_c))
  When HF content is musically strong (high SNR_H), cutoff stays near f_max; as tail becomes hiss-dominated (low SNR_H), cutoff moves toward f_min.
- Depth control: blend between dry input and filtered signal, or scale how far f_c may travel toward f_min (document). depth=0 ≈ bypass; depth=1 full curtain.
- Ranges: f_min in 500 Hz–8 kHz, f_max in 3–20 kHz with f_min < f_max ordering protection; clamp all setters.
- Filter: modulation-stable TPT (topology-preserving transform / SVF-style) low-pass, 12 or 24 dB/oct (prefer one well-documented choice, or cascade two 12 dB stages for 24). Update coeffs from smoothed log-frequency every sample or every few samples without zipper/clicks under continuous f_c motion.
- SNR_H input: accept externally computed high-band SNR (linear or dB — document) via setSnr or per-block process argument; optional lightweight internal HF energy follow if convenient, but external drive is enough for f.4 wiring.
- prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, numChannels)/reset(); process in-place or input→output; stereo with shared cutoff. No heap allocation after prepare.
- Expose setMinFreqHz, setMaxFreqHz, setDepth, setSnrRange(S_min,S_max), getCutoffHz for diagnostics.

Do NOT implement MultibandGate dual/tri laws. Do NOT edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists.txt (f.4). Do NOT write tests (f.5).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: HissCurtain computes Q_H = clamp((SNR_H - S_min)/(S_max - S_min), 0, 1)
HissCurtain maps cutoff in log domain: ln(f_c) = ln(f_min) + Q_H * (ln(f_max) - ln(f_min))
HissCurtain uses a modulation-stable TPT (or SVF-TPT) low-pass with log-frequency smoothing of f_c
HissCurtain clamps f_min to 500 Hz–8 kHz and f_max to 3–20 kHz with f_min < f_max protection
HissCurtain depth control bypasses or fully engages the curtain as documented
No heap allocation in the per-block process path after prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: implement TPT/SVF low-pass from first principles or thin JUCE dsp helpers
accept external SNR_H rather than owning full multiband detector
smooth ln(f_c) with a one-pole filter for click-free motion
use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
forbidden: implement dual/tri MultibandGate gain combiner here
use non-modulation-stable coefficient updates that click under continuous f_c motion
